verdicts.reason: A is just the original shrunk into a centre column: the grey background doesn't reach the sides, so it shows visible seams and dead side panels, and the quote and the author line are small. Still, the design is intact and readable. B breaks the design: the quote is crammed into the top-left of a huge empty red block, the author name floats off to the right of it, a stray underline sits under 'MODERN', and the skyline shrinks to a tiny strip in a separate white panel. The quote and the skyline no longer work together.
